metadata.title: Free Breathing App (No Download): Calm Anxiety, Sleep & Focus
metadata.description: Free breathing app: box breathing, 4-7-8, coherent breathing, and physiological sigh timers. No download, no signup. Start your session now.
metadata.socialDescription: A free breathing app that runs in your browser: box breathing, 4-7-8, coherent breathing (HRV), and the physiological sigh. No signup.
metadata.twitterDescription: A free breathing app that runs in your browser: box breathing, 4-7-8, coherent breathing (HRV), and the physiological sigh.
hero.title: Free breathing app
hero.intro: A simple breathing app that runs in your browser, no download and no signup. Use it for calm, focus, sleep, or a quick stress reset.
starter.title: Start a session
starter.body: Pick a breathing technique and press Start. You can adjust pacing, sound, and haptics.
included.title: What’s included
included.items.2: Coherent breathing (~5–6 breaths/min) for HRV training
features.items.0.title: Fast
features.items.0.body: Designed to load quickly and get you into a session within seconds.
features.items.1.title: Customizable
features.items.1.body: Adjust pacing and settings so the practice stays comfortable and sustainable.
features.items.2.title: Evidence-informed
features.items.2.body: Each guide includes practical instructions, safety notes, and references to relevant research.
popularTimers.title: Popular breathing timers
popularTimers.intro: Jump straight into the most common app-style breathing timers.

goals.title: Explore by goal
goals.intro: Use a quick reset, a running-specific recovery guide, or an advanced technique when you want a different kind of session.

visualizer.title: Breathing visualizer
visualizer.body: Want to see all 10 techniques with an interactive visual guide? Try the full breathing visualizer.
install.title: Can I install this like an app?
install.body: You can add it to your home screen from your browser (look for “Add to Home Screen”). This will create an app icon and open the visualizer in a standalone window.
